audits.observations: Root completed the ordered image-first second reading of the whole scan and both actual supplied halves, followed by both witnesses, every line of agreed text and the inventories. All 79 fresh crop recipes were personally viewed. Five margin previews initially lacked declared grayscale/contrast processing because of a helper defect; those five were regenerated with all declared settings and personally re-viewed before finalization. The two new margin crops were generated directly with those settings. The faint note remains uncertain, with no inferred sentence supplied. Enlargements confirm the faint equals sign and dotted i in the CM2 formula, both j/i index orders as actually written, the triangular Delta in the sigma-prime definition, all quotient parentheses and primes, the lower sloping geq bars, the double-bar leqq ranges, E in id_E, and the two-dot basis ellipsis. Both plus shapes are now read without a doubt mark; all repeated round indices and the exponent are qualified locally. The handwritten lineairement has no acute; semi invariants has no hyphen. Overtyped pour and du are qualified. Physical line divisions, the uncertain mark after al, live c.q.f d., final quptient, the extra locally cancelled letter between bi and en, the typed s beneath capital S, the raised number-point and the full heading loops are preserved. The final abbreviation under x overtyping has uncertain punctuation. All cancellations and insertion drawings were rechecked, including the broad black passage that remains physically unreadable. The upper diagonal of the pencil bracket is added. Manuscript 23 and archive 54 remain distinct. No context or mathematical proof check was used.
